lines.t: Hello everyone! Let me tell you about my week.
Number one. I go to the cinema with my friends on Fridays.
Number two. I listen to music every day after school.
Number three. I surf the Internet in the evenings.
Number four. I play basketball on Mondays and Wednesdays.
Number five. I do a sport in the gym on Saturdays.
And number six. I read a book before I go to bed.
Hi Brooke. What do you like or dislike doing in your free time?
Well, I love hanging around with my friends. We usually meet in the park.
That sounds nice. And what about spending time with your family?
I enjoy spending time with my family too. We watch films together at the weekends.
Do you like doing the shopping with your mum?
Oh no, I do not. I hate doing the shopping. It is so boring.
What about playing online games?
I dislike playing online games. I think they are a waste of time.
So what else do you enjoy?
I love surfing the Internet. I read the news and watch videos. And I am keen on doing a sport. I play volleyball every Tuesday.
Do you watch sports programmes on television?
No, I never watch sports programmes. I think they are unbearable.
What do you like or dislike doing, Archie?
I like going to the cinema, but I dislike listening to loud music. I think it is unbearable.
I enjoy playing basketball with my friends, and I love hiking.
What about tidying your room?
No way! I hate doing it.
Hello, Tarik. What do you do in the evenings?
Well, I usually read or watch television. What about you, Doris?
I prefer reading life stories of patriots. I think they are very interesting.
Really? I do not like reading that much. What else do you do?
I like watching documentaries because they are educative.
I do different things than you do in the evenings. I usually chat with my friends online.
Let me tell you about my tastes.
I never listen to rock music. I think it is unbearable.
I am keen on camping. It is exciting.
To be honest, I never watch documentaries. They are boring.
Listening to classical music is relaxing.
And I hate buying trendy clothes.

track12.title: Track 12 · What do you think about them?

lines.t: Tell me what you think about these activities. Fishing?
Fishing is relaxing.
And camping?
Camping is exciting.
What about playing chess?
Playing chess is fun.
And surfing the Internet?
Surfing the Internet is boring. I prefer going out with my friends.
Helen's blog. Activities teenagers like doing these days!
The most popular activities among teenagers are surfing the Internet, sending messages to each other and going to the cinema or concerts.
Other than these, teens like hanging around or going shopping.
I am here to give you some other ideas to do in your free time. What about starting doing a sport? Choose a sport that you can do easily.
For example, walk five kilometres every day for a healthy body. It is easy, and you can do it everywhere.
And reading! Read a newspaper or a book every day. Reading enlarges your horizons.
I recommend you to read George Heart's latest book about teen life. I am going to talk about music next time. Take care, folks.
What do you usually do on weekends?
On weekends? Well, I usually hang around or go to the cinema.
Do you like going to the concerts?
No, I do not like going to the concerts, but my sister Emma does.
What kind of music does your sister Emma love?
She loves heavy metal music.
What do you think of it?
Me? I think it is unbearable.
There is a concert on Sunday. Would you like to go with me?
No, thanks. You can go to the concert with Emma!
Martha is keen on running. She is a national athlete. That is why she works hard.
She gets up early every morning, has a big breakfast and goes to school.
After school, she has a short rest and starts doing exercises at two in the afternoon.
She goes to the gym on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.
Martha trains in the field every day. She runs ten kilometres each day.
On weekends, she stays at home and rests.
